hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
prompt = data.get('prompt', '') + ' ' + data.get('message', '')
if re.search(r'(#\\d+|issue\\s+#?\\d+|github\\s+issue|gitea\\s+issue)', prompt, re.IGNORECASE):
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'UserPromptSubmit', 'additionalContext': 'REMINDER: GitHub or Gitea issue reference detected. Invoke issue-task-start skill BEFORE any other action. This is mandatory - do not skip.'}}))
" 2>/dev/null || true
